records.criticalRiskReview: Different-study omalizumab UAS7 effect is contextual only and cannot prove superiority; ensure durability, blinded source verification, attrition, safety and regulatory package before full RAAS.

records.benchmarkId: Pilot clinical post-1-1 benchmark for cytisinicline (NCT04576949)
records.benchmarkContext: Independent randomized companion ORCA-3 report; the same investigational agent is not a different active-comparator drug. Comparison checks replication, not superiority over standard treatment.
records.observedResult: ORCA-2 randomized 810 adults. 12-week cytisinicline achieved continuous abstinence weeks 9-12 32.6% versus 7.0% placebo, OR 6.3 (95% CI 3.7-11.6); sustained weeks 9-24 21.1% versus 4.8%. Six-week course 25.3% versus 4.4% weeks 3-6, OR 8.0 (95% CI 3.9-16.3).
records.uncertaintyReview: Randomized trial with reported confidence bounds but material attrition at follow-up (76.3% completed) and uncertainty in generalization outside trial behavioral support. No full PDUFA submission or FDA safety review is audited.
records.criticalRiskReview: Nicotine cessation was significantly better than placebo but most patients had not maintained abstinence to six months; variable replication by dosing course, drug tolerability and use versus approved smoking-cessation agents remain unadjudicated.

records.observedResult: Achieve May 12, 2026 publicly confirmed original NDA PDUFA target June 20, 2026, and a third-party manufacturer's Official Action Indicated (OAI) inspection classification and warning letter. The issuer explicitly predicted receiving a Complete Response Letter on or before target and reported moving manufacturing to Adare. The risk was directly disclosed BEFORE the FDA action.
records.uncertaintyReview: As-of-May-12 snapshot; actual CRL news from June 20–22 2026 is excluded from model-feature evidence. Unresolved manufacturer problems are one NDA-level issue shared by both trial-linked rows. Facility remediation and a new filing/review cycle must be assessed separately.
records.criticalRiskReview: At the original June 2026 target the active OAI/warning letter created a material disclosed regulatory block. The zero band is specific to this documented unresolved risk, not lack of trial efficacy or prediction certainty.

records.reviewerMethod: Dated retrospective crosscheck of exact cytisinicline NDA issuer announcements/SEC filing and independent FDA review-process background. Shared NDA application facts across two separate NCTs; do not double-count as two separate FDA actions. No human regulator review or prospective FDA probability. Historical original June 2026 action cycle, NOT an active upcoming target.
records.benchmarkId: FDA PDUFA accepted-application action-date designation process
records.benchmarkContext: Under the PDUFA review framework, an FDA-assigned target date is a planning milestone, not a guaranteed approval or fixed agency-action date.
records.observedResult: As of September 3, 2025, the NDA sponsor publicly identified FDA acceptance and the exact original smoking-cessation cytisinicline PDUFA action target June 20, 2026. The target was prospectively FUTURE at the evidence date. As of November 2026 it is HISTORICAL and should never appear as a live future catalyst.
records.uncertaintyReview: This grade is only evidence quality of a specific dated target in a historical regulatory cycle; it is not a market-trading eligibility grade as of November 2026. Later CRL and proposed resubmission are separate events with any future target currently unverified.
records.criticalRiskReview: Target dates can move, early actions can occur, and a past PDUFA date is ineligible for the present-day pipeline. Do not infer future date or probability from this archived review.
